sources.title: Allenby Border Crossing: about
sources.officialityEvidence: The Israel Airports Authority operates the Allenby crossing and currently describes its Palestinian, tourist, Israeli, Palestinian Authority and Jordanian roles.
sources.supportingExcerpt: mainly for the Palestinian population and tourists with various citizenships.

sources.title: Israel Entry country and passport-type data
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Israel Entry API is operated by the Population and Immigration Authority and enumerates current national-passport entry treatment by country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The dataset separates regular national passports that require a permit from those that do not.

sources.title: Tourist Visa Requirements for Foreign Nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government collector is published by Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and distinguishes visa-required and visa-exempt foreign national passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist Visa Requirements for Foreign Nationals

sources.title: Government of Canada: Israel and Palestine travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: Global Affairs Canada publishes the current destination advice and expressly explains the interaction between Palestinian and Israeli entry rules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Palestine does not issue its own visas.

conditional.title: Palestinian Territory access is route-dependent for ETA-IL passports
conditional.summary: These ordinary passports normally use ETA-IL at Israeli-controlled entry points, while the accessible Palestinian area, crossing, permit and individual approval can produce a restricted outcome.
conditions: The ETA-IL route applies through Israeli-controlled ports of entry and does not itself establish access to every part of the Palestinian Territory.
West Bank or Gaza access can depend on the crossing, current security restrictions, population-registry status, permit coordination and individual approval.
No route-independent Palestinian ordinary-passport nationality schedule was found, so this record does not change the ranking status.

conditional.title: Palestinian Territory access is route-dependent for Israeli-visa-required passports
conditional.summary: These ordinary passports normally require an Israeli visitor visa at Israeli-controlled entry points, while the accessible Palestinian area, crossing, permit and individual approval can produce a restricted outcome.
conditions: The prior-visa route applies through Israeli-controlled ports of entry and does not itself establish access to every part of the Palestinian Territory.
West Bank or Gaza access can depend on the crossing, current security restrictions, population-registry status, permit coordination and individual approval.
No route-independent Palestinian ordinary-passport nationality schedule was found, so this record does not change the ranking status.
